briefV2: Published and read before final handoff; dependency revision 2
behavior: Transactional acquire/renew/release with 1s–5min TTL; server snapshot readTime sets deadlines; serverTimestamp audit fields; monotonic revision plus UUID token fences stale workers. completeLeaseRun commits transaction-only persistence callback and cursor atomically only for complete validated pages, then releases lease.
testCoverage: Five-way contention; renewal; persisted expiry takeover; stale renew/release/complete; partial page callback not invoked; write failure rolls back output and cursor; successful atomic commit; invalid job/duration
checks: NOT RUN: lead owns tests/build/emulator. Source self-review complete; final implementation review and compiler/runtime validation pending lead.
integrationRequirements: Internal module only, no index/public exports changed.
Consumer performs official reads outside transaction then calls completeLeaseRun only after full validated page; callback must be repeatable transaction reads/writes, bounded and no provider calls.
If an entire multi-page run must commit atomically, consumer must stage all pages first; this helper commits a validated page, not unvalidated full-run completeness.
Consumer must acquire and retain fencing handle and never write materialized results outside guarded transaction.
No scheduler/IAM/resource/provider or production operations executed.
limitations: Long-running callback must remain bounded; expiry checked at transaction readTime and transaction serialization fences takeover writes.
Opaque cursor completeness is consumer responsibility; helper rejects explicit partial result but cannot validate provider semantics.
productionReadiness: NOT_READY until lead compilation/integration and approved real collector/transport verification
